description: This file defines the HomeActivity class for an Android TV application. It manages the main home screen UI, including top navigation, hero banner carousel, and multiple horizontal rails of content loaded dynamically. It includes custom D-pad focus navigation, focus animations, scroll management to ensure the top bar visibility, and interactions with a ViewModel to load and observe data.

classes.name: HomeActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the TV app home screen, handling focus navigation, content loading, and UI interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, sets up UI components, and starts data loading.

methods.name: dispatchKeyEvent
methods.description: Records whether the last navigation input was an UP key, used to manage scroll behavior.

methods.name: setupTopMenu
methods.description: Configures the top navigation menu with focus behaviors and a default focus target.

methods.name: setupBannerCarousel
methods.description: Initializes the hero banner carousel, loads banner images, manages focus behaviors, and observes banner state.

methods.name: computeCenterScrollX
methods.description: Calculates the scroll X coordinate to center a child view inside a HorizontalScrollView.

methods.name: setupRails
methods.description: Creates multiple content rails, populates them dynamically, and manages focus navigation between rails and the hero banner.

methods.name: moveFocusToHeroBanner
methods.description: Sets focus to the hero banner or its children.

methods.name: moveFocusToTopNavHome
methods.description: Sets focus to the top navigation home button.

methods.name: moveFocusToFirstRailFirstItem
methods.description: Sets focus to the first item of the first content rail.

methods.name: ensureTopScrollIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the parent ScrollView to the top if focus entered the hero banner via DPAD_UP, ensuring the top menu is visible.

methods.name: isViewFullyVisible
methods.description: Checks if a view is fully visible within the viewport.

calls: startActivity() for login, main, and content info screens
collect() (coroutines observing ViewModel state and banner state)
